diagnostic_scope: Descriptive initial-condition and encounter slices; these do not prove optimal potion/block choices.
interpretation: Exploratory representation-plus-capacity comparison on two learner seeds and campaign-conditioned combat starts; not Act1 clear probability or proof of potion/block optimality. No model automatically promoted.

protocol.conclusion: No automatic promotion. A positive mean alone is insufficient; report the full paired 95% interval and each seed. Representation and additional capacity are changed together.
protocol.held_out: No held-out test gameplay or vocabulary fitting; builder minimum one reserved source campaign per region.
protocol.initialization: Fresh weights per learner seed; shared layers exactly equal between paired architectures; additional combat modules initialized after shared layers.
protocol.primary: Final sampled combat wins, with ordinary/elite/boss equally weighted, paired by source campaign.
protocol.statistics: 10000 paired campaign-cluster bootstrap draws; source campaign is resampled jointly across both fixed learner seeds and action repeats. Report per-seed and aggregate results. Pilot uncertainty is conditional on these two learner seeds.
protocol.vocabulary: Fit only public initial observations of every training start; frozen for all arms and seeds; no imitation.

scope_clarification: The original intent phrase no held-out test gameplay means no learned-policy test evaluation or test vocabulary fitting. Corpus construction necessarily played two reserved test source campaigns to generate starts; those starts were not used by this pilot.

analysis-review.json.findings: No blockers. Campaign bootstrap preserves within-campaign dependence across paired learner seeds and repeated action samples. All planned games remain in denominators. Synthetic grouping check passed. Per-seed interval wording corrected to fixed declared learner seeds; checkpoint checks labelled strict restores. Reviewer ran only a small synthetic read-only statistical check, not gameplay or training tests.
analysis-review.json.scope: Aggregate paired statistics, evaluator preflight, and MLflow binding

semantic-review.json.findings: No blocking correctness or public-information issues found. Reviewer read code/tests; did not execute tests or edit files.
semantic-review.json.scope: Public feature extraction, current-context pools, exact candidate joins, architecture/feature checkpoint versioning, PPO/imitation plumbing, experiment initialization and validation harness.
semantic-review.json.scope_clarification: The original intent says no held-out test gameplay. The corpus builder plays two reserved test source campaigns to generate starts. The pilot does not fit vocabulary from, train on, or evaluate learned policies on those test starts.
